title: Deck Building quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription:
Construction of a new elevated timber deck, 4.0m x 6.0m (twenty-four square metres), at the rear of the property.
Decking: Merbau 90x19mm standard grade, fixed with 50mm stainless steel screws.
Subframe: Treated pine H3 joists 90x45mm at 450mm centres, treated pine H3 bearers 140x45mm.
Footings: Twelve (12) concrete piers, 300mm diameter x 600mm deep, with galvanised post stirrups.
Fasteners: All structural connections with galvanised coach bolts and framing anchors.
Balustrade: Stainless steel wire balustrade, 1.0m high, with Merbau 90x90mm posts and 90x42mm Merbau top rail. Total balustrade length: 14.0 linear metres.
Stairs: Three (3) step Merbau staircase, 1.2m wide, with Merbau 90x19mm treads and treated pine H3 stringers.
workingDetail: Decking boards (Merbau, treated pine, composite), Joists and bearers, Concrete footings, Coach bolts and screws
